name: Chart/Stack-Bar-Chart
description:
How parts make up a total across periods, with a legend. The columns fill the plot edge to edge, Spacing/Gap/XSmall (8) apart and as wide as the count allows; each stack has Corner-Radius/Small on its top corners and a flat base.


Properties
Color: Primary (default) · Secondary — Secondary swaps Color Chart Sector/Primary and /Secondary (the first two series swap), for a chart led by Neutral Deep with the brand as its highlight. Code: palette="secondary"


Code: <StackBarChart> (Zen DS)


Header: Title · Show Hint — an info icon (20px, Content/Neutral/Light) that holds the chart's description in a Tooltip (code: hint) · Show Open; Show Icon is off by default (chart headers carry no icon). Metric: Show Metric Label (Body/Small/Regular, what the figure is; code: metricLabel) over Show Value (Display/4).
